projectState.summary: Byte 15b-a is approved and merged. It adds the first model critic on top of Byte 15a's deterministic melody repair substrate. `MelodyRepairTake` exposes a bounded candidate menu of raw, heuristic, and alternate chorus repairs; `src/ollama.ts` sends only scored candidate IDs and critique context to the model; the model can return only `selectedCandidateId` plus short prose fields. Valid model selections switch the active repaired chorus candidate through the existing lookahead material path, while invalid/failed/stale output falls back to the deterministic scorer. Claude's forward finding: the mechanism is safe, but the current candidate menu is too clustered to prove model value; next work should diversify candidate strategies and log model-pick versus deterministic-best score deltas.
